message.content:
This editorial illustration features a close-up, high-contrast portrait of a man’s face against a solid black background. The man, identified by small golden text at the lower left as "JOHN KEI," is shown from the bridge of his nose upwards, his head angled slightly downward and to the right. His skin is tan with visible pores, wrinkles on his forehead, and a slight furrow between his eyebrows. There are dark, brownish-red splatters across his left cheek and the bridge of his nose.

The large white serif text "TEMPO" spans the top third of the image. Above it, three headlines in yellow text read: "Wawancara Bos Yawadwipa," "Perang Konsesi Batu Bara," and "Tebar Duit di Kongres Demokrat." Below "TEMPO," smaller white text reads "EDISI 27 FEBRUARI-4 MARET 2012." In the bottom right, large white and gold serif text reads "GANGSTER KEI." A barcode and the price "Rp 27.000" appear at the bottom, alongside the phrase "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN." The composition is framed by a thin red vertical line on the far left.
